items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: That was one of his early tutors, and he loved Buster

ctx.x: periods. And he'd just disappear off the scene. After so long, you wouldn't see Charlie Parker -- he was gone.

He told me later on that sometimes he would go to Dallas, Texas, and spend time with Buster Smith, the saxophone player that wrote "One O'Clock Jump" with Basie, that used to play the lead alto with Basie. That was one of his early tutors, and he loved Buster, and he would go and spend time with Buster Smith, you know, in Dallas, Texas.
Did he say exactly how he got involved in ...(?)...?
